decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.text: The root prioritizes ordinary branch work and travel with water interruptions. It does not reduce or put up for removal any built capability. Rescuability, pool locality, saved memory and escaped-young maturity remain the existing delivery obligations and contradictions. Stage 2 must resolve core edges from evidence; no stage-2 disposition or flagship is granted by this run.

asks.text: Which core promise should define FeverWood: branch routes governing ordinary life above water with consequences, or a different experience missing from the recorded answers?
asks.decision: The stage-1 root wording; root approval is separate from selecting a flagship and certifying first touch.
asks.author: rm-role-designercodex-1794804230
asks.recommended_answer: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.
asks.why_no_pause: The November OWNER event selects daily branch routes with occasional tentacle interruptions. The October documented experience supplies the remembering black water. Implementation gaps attack delivery of this promise, not the obvious choice of promise. No evidence yet found for replacing that experience.
asks.answer: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.

inventory.text: FeverWood source, compiled assembly and biome registration ship as a wave-2 member of mandrake.rm.biomes. The development About file retains its standalone package identity. Current local manifest and DLL hashes agree. Installed-game agreement remains unmeasured.
The biome is hand-placed. Its worker returns -100 and the inert natural-placement setting has been removed.

Boughways, ground causeways and fertile bough-soil are painted through the shared causeway profile anchored to living boles. The pass restricts painting to its ground allowlist. Daily routes and the resulting branch-home experience require a live walk.

Ground-refusal converts remaining Soil/SoilRich to MarshyTerrain. Stilt platforms grant Heavy construction through the Bridge ancestry, while mirror pools inherit the deep-water foundation restrictions. Normal construction refusal and the usable stilt alternative remain live-scene obligations.
Mineable fever-trunk heartwood and a living core opt into EnvironmentalHazards living regrowth. The profile reuses Greentide toxin-sealed flooring and saved regrowth timers.
ScatterPools paints the registered mirror-pool terrain. TentacleWatch caches connected water clusters and uses largest-cluster size for set-piece eligibility under tentaclePoolsAreClusters.

The shared Tenant scans water adjacency, subtracts wild victims and downs colonist/player victims with a 2500-tick rescue deadline. Being carried clears the deadline. Snare limbs call this same service. Fair nearby rescue has owner backing and remains unmeasured in play.
A registered-pool mirror-break incident raises agitation and requests a timed CreatureBehaviors hush.

The usable mirror-list item and agitation overlay exist. Its read effect writes agitation around the reader using the reader's local value. Acquisition and an independent per-pool snapshot are incomplete.

Ordinary ambient rolls spawn feeler, snare, lash, porter or sentinel limbs, with a live cap and linger behavior. Damage starts retreat or severing, with flesh and respite consequences. Bloom is excluded from the ordinary weighted table.

An unmolested porter places loot and withdraws. Attacking it ends future porter rolls through a saved map-wide anger flag. Locality and increased pool hostility require correction against the documented porter consequences.

A qualifying large pool and accumulated encounter pressure can escalate into multiple limbs plus the eye. Eye damage accumulates during a withdrawal window, with moderate map-wide drive-off and severe map-wide permanent defeat.

The uranium suppressant, machining recipe, designator, workgiver and haul/dump job exist. The job checks feature state and surviving designation before consumption. Suppression updates map-wide clocks and optionally withdraws all limbs.

The meat-fed prison tank produces flesh, spleen chemicals and cream, teaches after successful product placement, and risks escape through damage or neglect. Current destruction routes spawn a breach-injured escapee on KillFinalize and quietly release on deconstruction. Older product-clock defaults are repaired lazily.

Only an armed tank escapee reaching registered water installs a tenant. Gaining a faction disarms installation. Current installation immediately clears the map-wide defeat flag and destroys the escapee.
The owner-approved several-day establishment/maturity interval with poisoning of that particular pool remains absent. The current water-arrival path immediately reinstates the ambient adult.

Tank/cask release arms a peaceful young that selects reachable water, prefers FeverWood pools, and schedules a gift on arrival. Due gifts remain queued while disabled, and unplaced rolls retry. State is serialized and queue lengths repaired on load.

Generic keeper, display-tank, cask-trader and story-line hooks support the campaign's Sporefall display tank, enhanced gift and goodwill cost. Freed-display state persists. A pure static campaign-wiring selftest passed this run.

Stake designations, nonlethal downing, hauling, restraint and release exist for living bait. Bait value determines draw, and a triggered stake can lock voluntary release. Normal designator/workgiver flow is absent from the existing demonstration.

The first front is randomly kurreth or the loaded Webwork front, with free skreth fallback. A possible second wave is delayed and uses the first actual entry edge for opposite arrival under true-fronts settings. Raiders receive an initial goto toward the stake followed by an assault lord. Pending wave state is saved.

The real-geometry path builds a kernel-planned walled/roofed room chain with an entrance and queen room. The old painting-only path remains setting-selectable. Physical enclosure and reachability have readout methods, with no complete live geometry scene in validation.py.

Kurreth workers and queen opt into CreatureBehaviors reaction sources, alarm responders and home tethers. The proof script stages a line of ants for hop/rally behavior, separate from generated dungeon geometry.

A shallow worker-room thornbug herd is placed by the hive generator and herded back by the saved hive component. This implements placement and return-to-room behavior. Nectar production and a functioning dungeon farm remain live proof obligations.

Adult bostrach guards are stationed at deeper corridor chokes, tethered and refed while a wild worker of the feeder race exists. Worker-to-guard rally has a pad proof. Generated choke use, hunger and feeder-removal controls remain unproven.

A matching alarm seals the corridor behind the intruder with temporary resin plugs, skipping pawn cells and using MoveAside for loose contents. Actual retreat-route change needs a generated-hive interaction scene.
Historical kurreth live theft and column/hive raid-back were subsequently cut. The current raid lord disables theft and kidnapping. Deleted mechanics receive absence coverage in the later plan.

failure_modes: The branches fail to govern ordinary work and travel. The crown reads as painted ground, while the promised mud defense and living-wood decisions never affect daily play.

Water consequences fail to remain legible and consistent. Unrelated pools share anger or treatment, a defeated creature still strikes through the shared Tenant, reload erases a rescue deadline, or an escapee skips the owner-approved intervention interval.

The mod passes isolated mock fixtures while the player cannot complete its promised journeys. Real shore rescue, prisoner upkeep/return/gift, living-bait two-front tension, hive retreat and oil harvest/ignition need observable actions, useful controls and complete recovery.

missing_entry_points.finding: A normal branch-home work route, build-refusal/stilt alternative and mine/regrow/seal journey have no dedicated entry points in the current FeverWood script.
Pool generation/reach, ordinary real shore exposure, near/far rescue, set-piece eye outcomes, mirror-break and usable intelligence have no full acceptance scenes.
World tally, escape establishment, the approved maturity window, deliberate return, owed-gift retries and campaign display consequences lack complete live scenes.
Generated dungeon route, farm tending and alarm sealing need a full hive journey. Existing rally/guard pad scenes cover their isolated links.
Fear-gated nectar, ollareth alarm, failed-tame behavior, silloch prey leash, borer diet, bird flight/products/theft and overlapping hush reasons lack behavior scenes.
Generated salvage, scanner optional checkouts, ecological plant roles and retired-mechanic absence need ordinary coverage checks.
Mid-action reload/retry/reordered-action walk, whole-feature all-off behavior and a discriminating observation/recovery instrument remain unimplemented scene coverage.

root.text: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.

root.interpretation: The branch-led daily-life and consequential-water promise. This wording is the delegated agent synthesis. It is not an owner quotation or a claim of delivered live behavior. It supplies no flagship pick or first-touch certification.
